findings.evidence: Star.lean:398-401 `theorem not_isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix (h : ∑ i, ((ℓ i : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹ ≤ (Fintype.card α : ℚ) - 2) : ¬ IsFiniteType (starCartanMatrix ℓ)`; cf. Basic.lean:660, 671 which take no hypothesis.
findings.fix: Rename to `not_isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_of_sum_inv_le` (hypothesis after `of_`, per the conventions' "hypotheses separated by `of`" rule).
findings.issue: `not_isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix` carries a hypothesis (`∑ (ℓ i + 1)⁻¹ ≤ card α - 2`) that the name does not record, so it reads as the false claim that no star Cartan matrix is of finite type — types A, D, E₆₋₈ are all `starCartanMatrix` instances and are of finite type. The adjacent `not_isFiniteType_affineA₂` / `not_isFiniteType_affineD₄` are genuinely unconditional, so the shared shape is misleading.

findings.fix: Rename to `not_isFiniteType_affineE₆`, `not_isFiniteType_affineE₇`, `not_isFiniteType_affineE₈`, matching the two existing affine exclusions; update the module docstring list at lines 61-62.
findings.issue: `not_isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_affineE₆` (and `…affineE₇` line 488, `…affineE₈` line 496) name the construction used rather than the object, and diverge from the established pattern for exactly this kind of statement in the same directory: `TauCeti.not_isFiniteType_affineA₂` (Basic.lean:660) and `TauCeti.not_isFiniteType_affineD₄` (Basic.lean:671).

findings.evidence: Star.lean:252 `private theorem chainEntry_centre_row`; grep for `centre` across `TauCeti/` finds it only in prose elsewhere, and e.g. `TauCeti/Algebra/Subalgebra/Center.lean` uses the American spelling in names.
findings.issue: `chainEntry_centre_row` uses British spelling in a declaration name; the conventions require American spelling ("Declaration names use American English spelling", contrasted explicitly with documentation, where `centre` in the docstrings is fine). It is the only British-spelled declaration name in the repo.

Two names omit the value proved. `starMark_none_eq` differs from the simp lemma `starMark_none` (line 150) only by a contentless `_eq`, giving no hint of the factored right-hand side; `sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_some` (line 276) proves `= 0` without saying so, while its sibling `…_none` (line 321) proves a formula — the pair is indistinguishable from the names.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:637-638 `(hx : ∀ i, x i * ∑ j, (A i j : ℚ) * x j ≤ 0)`; Basic.lean:317 `theorem sum_apply_mul_apply_lt_four … : ∑ j ∈ s, A i j * A j i < 4`.
findings.fix: Rename to `eq_zero_of_forall_mul_sum_apply_mul_nonpos`, consistent with the `apply` convention of the same namespace; update the docstring list entry in the module header and the reference at Star.lean:30.
findings.issue: `eq_zero_of_forall_mul_sum_nonpos` leaves the summand unnamed, so the hypothesis could equally be `x i * ∑ j, x j ≤ 0`. The surrounding namespace spells matrix entries `apply`: `sum_apply_mul_apply_lt_four`, `one_le_apply_mul_apply`, `apply_eq_zero_of_apply_ne_zero`.

summary: Two name-level defects: `not_isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix` asserts unconditionally what holds only under a hypothesis, and the three affine corollaries break the `not_isFiniteType_affine…` pattern already set in the same directory. Minor: a British-spelled declaration name and two names that omit the value they prove.
